cfg.engine.path: Custom path to the analysis engine executable. Leave empty to use the bundled binary for the current platform.
cfg.index.onStartup: Automatically build the index in the background after opening the workspace.
cfg.index.autoRebuildOnSave: Incrementally rebuild affected symbols and subgraph on save.
cfg.index.parallelism: Number of parsing threads. 0 = auto (CPU cores).
cfg.index.maxFiles: Maximum number of files to scan in one indexing run.
cfg.index.fileSizeLimitKB: Skip deep parsing for files larger than this size (KB).
cfg.files.include: Glob patterns of files to index.
cfg.files.exclude: Glob patterns of files to exclude.
cfg.deps.types: Analyze class inheritance and type dependencies.
cfg.deps.symbols: Analyze symbol definitions and cross references.
cfg.graph.defaultDepth: Default expansion depth k for the dependency graph.
cfg.graph.direction: Dependency direction: both / who depends on me / what I depend on.
cfg.graph.maxNodes: Maximum number of nodes rendered in one graph; clustering kicks in beyond this.
cfg.graph.clusterByDirectory: Enable directory clustering when the panel opens. Very large graphs (>400 nodes) cluster automatically.
cfg.cache.enabled: Enable on-disk cache to speed up subsequent startups.
cfg.cache.directory: Cache directory (defaults to .vscode/depscan-cache in the workspace).
cfg.checks.enabled: Report architecture boundary issues (public headers pulling in internals, dependency cycles between directories) to the Problems panel.
